stage: Data intake and target/reference feasibility only; no newfit authorized by this file
persistent_user_goal: public real plus synthetic allowed; current223 evaluation-only; no newPnP
selection: Official metadata/category/source-subset only; fixed deterministic SHA sample before image view; preserve every chosen row including unusable instances
license: Official LOCO CC0 repository saved by intake; no inference about other datasets
source_split: Five official environments are candidate groups, not automatically five proven independent capture families
Check image and known-source file/pixel hashes, recording/near-duplicate lineage before train/VAL
Current223 SHA denylist evaluationprovenance only, no current RGB/annotation/model-score reads
teacher_admission: Official COCO bbox identifies annotation entity only; never assume single whole pallet or native8 correspondence
Record physical instance and whether bbox covers multiple stacked pallets before reference labels
Do not relabel bbox-interior as visible canonical point or bbox-edge as a physical corner
Visible physical cue is conditional teacher until native8 mapping independently supported; unassigned semantic ID remains UNKNOWN
Fully opaque controlled cover may provide externalE for same fixed originally-visible cue; sourceU/MISS/partial cover remainU
SelfS requires separate verified geometry/renderer evidence; not inferred from visiblemask zero
Keep reference/range, source identity and alpha/GT outside classifier inputs
model_scope_notes: V72 has no explicit native keypoint ID input; arbitrary per-object fixed cues are not interchangeable native8 labels
Later head may consume known initializer native index and input-only target context; no private GT reference or recentering
Public generic cue localization may be auxiliary supervision, not fabricated canonical8 classification truth
Uniform source proposal grid is emulated sampling, not actual deployed initializer distribution; preserve source boundary
fit_policy: No newfit until actual source annotation/instance/native8 feasibility counts and source-only validation groups are frozen
Current223 cannot select any later architecture/checkpoint/threshold; all future findings remain development diagnostics unless a fresh final holdout exists
V72 source failure is retained and its checkpoint/threshold remain unchanged
